title: Microsoft Dataverse: richer record labels for Copilot /mention in Microsoft 365 apps
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, environment setting, navigation path and required administrator role are supported. It distinguishes the existing search setting's documented default from the unstated arrival behaviour of the label change, and does not invent a licence, meter or automation command.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: Microsoft plans richer Dataverse, Dynamics 365 and Power Apps record reference labels for Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: End users of Microsoft 365 Copilot will see improved Microsoft Dataverse, Dynamics 365, and Power Apps record references in Context IQ with richer, more descriptive labels

claims.claim: The roadmap describes labels containing environment, app and table information.
claims.quote: richer, more descriptive labels that include environment, app, and table information.

claims.claim: The roadmap calls the surface Context IQ.
claims.quote: record references in Context IQ

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn describes the enhanced label as Environment Name + App Name + Record Name.
claims.quote: Each record is displayed with an enhanced label that includes the **Environment Name** + **App Name** + **Record Name**, helping users quickly identify the correct record and its source.

claims.claim: The /mention experience offers recently viewed Dynamics 365 and Power Apps records, including records viewed in model-driven apps.
claims.quote: Most recently viewed Dynamics 365 and Power Apps records are available in Microsoft 365 Copilot through the /mention experience

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: When the same record is opened through multiple apps, its label reflects the most recently used app.
claims.quote: If you access the same record through multiple apps, the label reflects the most recently used app from which you viewed the record.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: A viewed record can take up to 15 minutes to become available through /mention.
claims.quote: It can take up to 15 minutes after you view a record on your Dynamics 365 or model-driven apps before you can **/mention** that record on Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in your productivity apps, like Outlook web client.

claims.claim: The feature page describes /mention in Outlook on the web, Copilot Chat, Researcher, Word and Teams.
claims.quote:
## Link to business records in email messages in your Outlook web client
### Copilot Chat
## Link to business records in Copilot Chat, Researcher, Word, and Teams clients

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Manage feature settings lists On as the default for Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps.
claims.quote: | Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps | You can quickly enable your users to access the records they most recently used in their application. The records are available in the Outlook Web client using a simple /mention gesture. | On |

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The sources do not state what the new label format does on arrival, separately from the existing /mention setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Dataverse" "record" "/mention" "label" "default". Read the roadmap record, Use /mention to link to business records via Microsoft 365 Copilot, and the relevant default and Search sections of Manage feature settings; none states label-specific arrival behaviour.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published licensing specific to this label change, so its licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention Microsoft 365 Copilot record labels licensing billing requirements meter; "/mention" "licensing" "Copilot" "Dataverse". Read the feature page, Power Platform licensing overview and Copilot license options; no label-change-specific licensing was found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The /mention feature page names no licence requirement.
claims.quote: Searched: "/mention" "licensing" "Copilot" "Dataverse". Read Use /mention to link to business records via Microsoft 365 Copilot in full, including its enablement instructions and Important notices; it names no licence.

claims.claim: The /mention feature page names no meter.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention Microsoft 365 Copilot record labels licensing billing requirements meter. Read Use /mention to link to business records via Microsoft 365 Copilot in full; it names no meter.

claims.claim: No charge for the setting itself is documented in the sources checked.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention Microsoft 365 Copilot record labels licensing billing requirements meter. Opened the /mention page, Manage feature settings and Power Platform licensing overview; none documents a charge for this setting.

claims.claim: No separate meter for the label change is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention Microsoft 365 Copilot record labels licensing billing requirements meter. Opened the /mention page, Power Platform licensing overview and Copilot license options; found no separate meter for enhanced labels.

claims.claim: The setting is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Search > Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps.
claims.quote: select **Manage** ... select **Environments** ... select an environment ... select **Settings** ... Expand **Product**, and then select **Features** ... Under the **Search** section, turn on **Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps**.

claims.where: controls[0].governs and scope; summary; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps controls /mention record availability per environment.
claims.quote:
When you turn on this setting, you can link to business records in productivity apps by using the **/mention** feature.
4. On the **Environments** page, select an environment.

claims.claim: No API, PowerShell or CLI equivalent for this specific environment setting was found.
claims.quote: Searched: "Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps" API PowerShell organization setting; "/mention" "Power Platform API"; "/mention" "pac admin". Read feature instructions, pac admin excerpts and searched organization Web API reference for mention, ContextIQ and Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: No separate switch governing the enhanced label format is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "/mention" "label" "switch" Dataverse; "Dataverse" "record" "/mention" "label" "default". Read the /mention feature page and relevant Manage feature settings sections; neither documents a separate label-format switch.

claims.claim: A small set of Dataverse data syncs with Microsoft 365 data for this experience.
claims.quote: A small set of data from Dataverse syncs with Microsoft 365 data.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The sync might cross geo boundaries in multi-geo organisations.
claims.quote: This sync might cross geo boundaries for multi-geo organizations where the Dataverse data might be in a different geographic region than the data stored for a user in Microsoft 365.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The sync crosses service and compliance boundaries between Dataverse and Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: Be aware that this sync also crosses service and compliance boundaries between the two platforms.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Synced data includes the environment name, app name, record name and a link to the most recently used record.
claims.quote: Synced data includes the environment name, app name, and record name, and a link to the most recently used record.

claims.claim: Updates to synced data update the record in Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: If you make any changes to the synced data, including updates or deletions, the record updates or deletes in Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Deletions of synced data delete the record in Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: If you make any changes to the synced data, including updates or deletions, the record updates or deletes in Microsoft 365.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Only records a user has access to and has most recently used are offered.
claims.quote: Security is top of mind, so only records that a user has access to and most recently used are available in the Microsoft 365 Copilot and productivity apps.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: An email recipient needs environment access, security roles granting data access and access to the shared record.
claims.quote: The recipient of the email must have access to the environment with security roles that grant access to the data and must be able to access the shared record.

claims.claim: The feature documentation does not explain the /mention authorisation mechanism beyond its access requirements.
claims.quote: Searched: "Dataverse" "/mention" "authorization" "actions". Read the /mention feature page in full; it states user access and recipient role requirements but no further /mention authorisation mechanism. Other results concerned general Dataverse security or unrelated integrations.

claims.claim: Researcher uses a referenced record as contextual grounding.
claims.quote: Currently, Researcher uses the referenced record as contextual grounding to gather and synthesize information from the web and your Microsoft 365 productivity data (such as emails, files, meetings, and chats).

claims.claim: Researcher does not currently retrieve or reason over live Dynamics 365 or Power Apps data associated with the referenced record.
claims.quote: Researcher doesn't currently retrieve or reason over live Dynamics 365 or Power Apps data associated with the referenced record.

claims.claim: Copilot uses the referenced record as context to ground its response.
claims.quote: Copilot uses the referenced record as context to ground its response and perform actions against the relevant business data.

claims.claim: The feature page says Copilot can perform actions against relevant business data using the referenced record.
claims.quote: Copilot uses the referenced record as context to ground its response and perform actions against the relevant business data.

claims.claim: The feature page does not enumerate which actions against the referenced business data are supported.
claims.quote: Searched: "Dataverse" "/mention" "authorization" "actions". Read the feature page in full: it provides prompts and email, Word and Teams examples, but no enumeration of supported actions against the referenced Dynamics 365 or Power Apps business data.

claims.claim: Manage feature settings requires the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.
claims.quote: Ensure you have the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.

claims.claim: The /mention page does not name an administrator role for changing the setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Dataverse" "/mention" "authorization" "actions". Read the /mention feature page in full and the administrator prerequisite in Manage feature settings; the former names recipient security roles but no administrator role for updating this setting.

claims.claim: The roadmap record names neither a licence nor a meter for this change.
claims.quote: End users of Microsoft 365 Copilot will see improved Microsoft Dataverse, Dynamics 365, and Power Apps record references in Context IQ with richer, more descriptive labels that include environment, app, and table information.
